text:
Based on the provided abstract, the study is an empirical investigation that uses expert interviews and thematic analysis to examine how investors currently perceive and integrate responsible AI into ESG investment analyses. It finds that incorporating AI into ESG analyses is not yet an established practice and highlights the need for standardized metrics and governance awareness.

The candidate hypothesis proposes developing a technical machine learning model—specifically a "Dual-Input Generative Adversarial Network (DI-GAN)" for predicting ESG scores using sentiment analysis and industry benchmarks—which is not proposed, developed, or tested anywhere in the study.

VERDICT: REJECT
